name: bitmap-image
title: A picture in the document
summary: A PNG embedded with resources.bitmaps and drawn in canvases with drawScaledBitmap: one cropped to fill its box, one fitted inside it.
prompt: Show an image embedded in the document, once cropped to fill and once fitted inside its box.
hand_built: Drawing a bitmap with drawScaledBitmap and its scale types is the lesson; for album or cover art use CoverArt, whose image slot takes the same drawScaledBitmap canvas and falls back to a generated cover.
teaches: resources.bitmaps takes {"base64": ...} or {"file": ...}, PNG only, and embeds the bytes
drawScaledBitmap: src is in image pixels, dst in dp, scaleType 0 none, 1 inside, 2 fill width, 3 fill height, 4 fit, 5 crop, 6 stretch, 7 fixed scale
pitfalls: The image's bytes go into the document, so its size is the PNG's size: keep images small
drawBitmap needs right and bottom here
The Java parser has these draw commands but not resources.bitmaps: there the host supplies images, so this document's bytes differ from Java's

snippets.note: a named PNG as base64; {"file": "a.png"} also works
cropped to fill, sized from the box

check.describe: Two pictures of four coloured quadrants: the left crops to fill its box, the right fits inside with bands above and below

java_difference: the Java parser has no resources.bitmaps: images come from the host through defineBitmap
